top_signals.title: Hurricane Isaias Slams Florida Panhandle
top_signals.summary: AccuWeather Correspondent Bill Wadell joins hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend from Pensacola Beach, Florida, where Hurricane Isaias made landfall as a Category 2 storm, bringing damaging winds, flooding and widespread power outages across the Gulf Coast. Wadell says the storm has weakened as it moves inland, but downed power lines, debris and continued flooding remain concerns as crews begin restoring electricity and assessing the damage. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
